videos.caption: Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Once cooked, add leftover rice, soy sauce, green onion and light butter. Mix gently till coated and fluffy. Honey Butter Fried Chicken  Recipe ⬇️  Insanely crispy, double-fried Korean chicken tossed in a sweet, buttery garlic honey glaze. Perfectly crunchy, sticky, and absolutely loaded with flavor! Ingredients Chicken & Marinade 3–4 lb bone-in chicken pieces 2 cups buttermilk 2 eggs 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp gochugaru Crispy Coating 2 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup cornstarch 2 tsp kosher salt 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp baking powder Peanut oil for frying Honey Butter Glaze 5 tbsp unsalted butter ⅓ cup honey 5–6 garlic cloves, minced 1½ tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp gochugaru ½ tsp toasted sesame oil Garnish Sesame seeds Sliced green onions Flaky salt Directions Mix buttermilk, eggs, soy sauce, and gochugaru. Add chicken and marinate in the refrigerator for 1–4 hours. Combine flour, cornstarch, and seasonings. Mix in 2–3 tbsp marinade to create crispy flour clumps. Coat chicken thoroughly, pressing the flour into every piece. Rest 10 minutes. Fry chicken in batches at 325–335°F for 10–14 minutes, depending on size, until cooked through (165°F minimum; 175–185°F is ideal for dark meat). Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Increase oil to 375°F and fry again for 1½–3 minutes until deeply golden and extra crispy. Melt butter over medium-low heat and sauté garlic for 30–60 seconds. Add honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, gochugaru, and sesame oil. Simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Toss crispy chicken in the warm honey butter glaze until evenly coated. Finish with sesame seeds, green onions, and flaky salt. Serve immediately! #recipe #cooking #friedchicken #comfortfood #hothoney

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

One-Pan Chicken & Rice aka Arroz con Pollo 🥘 @HexClad @Goya Foods @Kerrygold USA @getgraza  Ingredients * 2–3 lbs chicken thighs * 2 cups rice * 4 cups chicken broth or water * 1 red bell pepper, diced * ½ medium onion, diced * ½ cup carrots, diced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 2–3 tbsp butter * Olive oil * 1-2 tbsp chicken bouillon * Salt, to taste * Fresh cilantro, for garnish * Paprika * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Goya Adobo seasoning Instructions 1. Dice the red bell pepper, onion, and carrots, and mince the garlic. 2. Season both sides of the chicken thighs with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Goya Adobo. 3. Heat a little olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sear the chicken thighs for about 4 minutes per side, or until they develop a beautiful golden crust. Remove the chicken and set aside. 4. In the same pan, add the bell pepper, onion, carrots, and garlic. Add 2–3 tablespoons of butter and sauté for a few minutes, until fragrant. 5. Add 2 cups of rice and sauté it with the vegetables for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Pour in 4 cups of chicken broth (or water) and stir in chicken bouillon. Taste the liquid and add salt or more chicken bouillon if needed. 7. Nestle the chicken thighs back on top of the rice. Pour in any juices that collected on the plate—don’t waste that flavor! 8. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked (165°F internally). 9. Turn off the heat and leave the pan covered for another 5–10 minutes before serving. 10. Finish with fresh cilantro and serve. #chickenandrice #EasyRecipe #mealprep #arrozconpollo #DinnerIdeas

Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Lastly add garlic and cook until translucent for about 30 seconds  - Add 2 tbsp of flour  - Add about 2-3 tbsp of tomato paste and cook for about 1-2 minute  - Add wine and stir and cook for about 3-4 minutes occasionally until it’s reduced about half way  - Add beef broth  - Add seasonings listed above,  the kinder packet, beef bouillon cube, worcestershire sauce and stirr  - Add the chuck and top with the fresh parsley,  thyme, bayl leaves and cover and place in oven - Add in oven and cook for about 2 hours   - After 2  hours remove from oven and add the carrots, potatoes and give it a slight stir  -  Place back in oven for about 1 hour until fully cooked and veggies are tender  - Lastly, serve and enjoy!

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. Season cubed chicken with all seasonings. Cook in olive oil until golden and fully cooked (165°F).   3. Transfer chicken to a plate. Lower heat to medium-low and melt butter in the same skillet. Add the same seasonings and Dijon mustard. 4. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes. 5. Sprinkle in mozzarella, parmesan, and pepper jack. Stir until creamy, adding another splash of heavy cream if needed. 6. Add pasta and chicken back in, toss until coated, and serve! I didn’t measure my seasonings, just added everything to taste! YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Smothered Chicken with Creamy Onion Gravy Ingredients 1. 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 cup all-purpose flour 7. 3 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 large onion, thinly sliced 9. 3 cups chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 2 tbsp butter 12. 1 tsp dried thyme 13. 1 tbsp cornstarch 14. 2 tbsp water Recipe 1. Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. 2. Lightly dredge each piece in flour, shaking off excess. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken on both sides until golden. 5. Transfer the chicken to a slow cooker. 6. Add sliced onions over the chicken. 7. Pour in chicken broth and sprinkle with thyme. 8. Cover and cook on LOW for 5-6 hours. 9. Remove the chicken carefully and keep warm. 10. Stir heavy cream and butter into the cooking liquid. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl. 12. Stir the slurry into the gravy and cook until thickened. 13. Return the chicken to the slow cooker and coat with the gravy. 14. Let cook for another 15 minutes. 15. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or biscuits. Follow for more delicious recipes and easy family dinner ideas.

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

This one starts out as a very orderly blue grid and ends up feeling like a cutaway view into a hidden room. Everything is colored with sand: the outer cube, the inner walls, and the pink floor tiles tucked into the center. What makes it work so well is the contrast — cool blue on the outside, warmer pink details inside, all locked into that clean perspective. It lands somewhere between pixel architecture, a tiny tiled room, and an impossible object. I especially like that it doesn’t need motion to feel dimensional. The structure does all the work. Visual artist Jason Cook  creates kinetic sculptures and robotic installations using electronics, programming and mechanical engineering. In The Walking Chair (2025), an ordinary wooden chair is transformed into a moving machine. A system of motors, mechanical parts and electronic components is attached beneath the seat, allowing the chair’s legs to move. By giving a familiar piece of furniture the ability to walk, Cook changes the way we perceive an everyday object. The chair is no longer simply something we sit on  it becomes an object with a movement of its own. #art #artist #weird #chair #avantgarde

Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Marry Me Chicken Lasagna Soup Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients Chicken 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs ¾ tsp Italian seasoning ¾ tsp garlic powder ¾ tsp onion powder ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp kosher salt ½ tsp black pepper Soup ¾ lb sweet Italian sausage 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil 1 medium yellow onion, diced 4 garlic cloves, minced ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 2½ tbsp tomato paste 1 (14.5 oz) can petite diced tomatoes 5 cups low-sodium chicken broth, plus extra as needed ¾ cup heavy cream ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan 1 Parmesan rind 3 oz baby spinach 8 lasagna noodles, broken ¾ tsp Better Than Bouillon Roasted Garlic Base ¾ tsp dried oregano ⅛ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) Fresh basil 1½ tsp lemon juice Salt and pepper to taste Lemon Ricotta 15 oz whole-milk ricotta ½ cup shredded mozzarella ¼ cup grated Parmesan Zest of 1 lemon 1 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tbsp chopped parsley 1 tbsp chopped basil Salt and pepper to taste Directions Season chicken with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Brown sausage in sun-dried tomato oil. Remove, then sear chicken until golden. Reserve one thigh for topping and chop the rest. Sauté onion in the drippings. Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and tomato paste. Stir in oregano and roasted garlic base. Deglaze with broth, then add diced tomatoes, sausage, chopped chicken, and Parmesan rind. Simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Mix all lemon ricotta ingredients and refrigerate until serving. Remove Parmesan rind. Add broken lasagna noodles and simmer until tender, stirring frequently. Add broth if needed. Reduce heat to low. Stir in cream, spinach, Parmesan, fresh basil, and lemon juice. Season to taste. Cube and crisp the reserved chicken in a skillet until golden and fully cooked. Serve with a generous scoop of lemon ricotta, crispy chicken, fresh Parmesan, and basil. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

Garlic Herb Butter Roasted Chicken Quarters with Potatoes & Carrots 🤤 recipe below & follow for more easy meal ideas! . An easy, cozy dinner that takes about 5 minutes to prep! Juicy, seasoned chicken quarters roasted over tender potatoes and carrots with garlic, fresh rosemary, and buttery herb goodness. Everything cooks together in one dish, and the best part? Almost no cleanup! This is the kind of dinner I love making for my family. ❤️ . Ingredients: -4 chicken leg quarters -1 pound Petite mini potatoes (enough to cover the bottom of your casserole dish) -4 carrots, cut into smaller pieces -1 tbsp minced garlic -Olive oil -Salt & pepper -Garlic powder -Onion powder -Paprika -Kinder’s Buttery Herb & Garlic seasoning -4 tbsp Kerrygold Garlic & Herb Butter, cut into 4 slices -2 sprigs fresh rosemary . 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Add mini potatoes and chopped carrots to a casserole dish. Add minced garlic, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Toss everything together. 3. In a large bowl, add chicken quarters and drizzle with olive oil. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Kinder’s Buttery Herb & Garlic seasoning. Toss until evenly coated. 4. Arrange chicken quarters over the potatoes and carrots. 5. Add additional seasoning on top if needed. Place one slice of garlic herb butter on each chicken quarter and tuck the rosemary sprigs around the chicken. 6. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30–35 minutes. 7. Remove foil and bake for another 30–35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F and the skin is golden and crispy. 8. Make sure the potatoes and carrots are fork-tender. Serve and enjoy! 🥰 . #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #foodtiktok #foodie #fyp @Le Creuset @Kinder's Flavors @Kerrygold USA

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Memo is a wheeled home robot from Sunday Robotics, a Mountain View startup founded by Stanford PhDs Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi. Unveiled in November 2025, it’s built to handle real household chores like loading the dishwasher, clearing tables, folding laundry, and even making espresso. Standing about 5'7" and weighing 170 lbs, Memo moves on a stable wheeled base and uses a telescoping spine to reach up to 6'10". Instead of human-like hands, it has dual grippers designed for strength and precision, wrapped in a soft silicone shell to stay safe around kids, pets, and furniture. It runs for about 4 hours per charge, can recharge to 80% in an hour, and travels at up to 1 m/s. Memo is powered by the ACT-1 foundation model, trained not on lab robots but on 10 million episodes of humans doing chores, captured with low-cost Skill Capture Gloves in over 500 homes. As a result, it can complete long, multi-step tasks—like a 33-step table-to-dishwasher routine—and generalize to new kitchens without teleoperation. Sunday is launching a 2026 beta with “Founding Families,” pitching Memo as a customizable, safe, skill-learning home appliance for single-floor homes.#Techtok #robotics #ainews #autonomous #futuretech

Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

Lemon Chicken Just Got an Upgrade 🍋🧄 This is one of our favorite dinners to make during the week and it’s going to be yours too. Lemon Garlic Chicken with Cherry Tomatoes has a little bit of everything to please anyone. I think this one really takes lemon chicken to the next level with the chili pepper garlic and tomato for a quick one pan meal that just tastes good every single time. Ingredients: 1 lb Thinly sliced chicken breast filets 1 cup Cherry tomatoes (halved) 3 cloves Garlic (chopped) 1/4 cup White wine Juice of 1 lemon Flour Olive Oil Salt and Pepper Chili pepper Knob of butter Chopped parsley Directions:  1. Thinly slice chicken breast filets and toss in flour. 2. Sear the chicken in olive oil on both sides. 3. Season with salt and pepper. 4. Add in the white wine. 5. Once the alcohol cooks out, add in tomatoes, garlic, chili pepper, and the juice of 1 lemon. 6. Cook until the tomatoes start to wilt. 7. Finish it off with butter and parsley. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Creamy Chicken & Leek Puff Pastry Hand Pies 🥧 My husband made these for dinner earlier this week and I knew right away we had to get this one up on the website ASAP…they’re SO good! The filling is delicious enough to eat on its own, but wrapped in flaky puff pastry...this is my ideal comfort food. Pot pie, but portable! Full recipe is linked in our profile or head straight to https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/chicken-and-leek-hand-pies/ 2 tablespoons butter 1 cup sliced leeks white and pale green parts (1 large leek), halved lengthwise then sliced ¼ in ½ teaspoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour ½ cup chicken stock 1 cup shredded rotisserie chicken 2 tablespoons sour cream or crème fraîche ¾ teaspoon Dijon mustard 1½ teaspoon fresh tarragon finely chopped 1½ teaspoon fresh thyme finely chopped ¼ teaspoon black pepper 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed but cold 1 egg + 1 teaspoon water, beaten Fresh thyme sprigs  In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the leeks and salt, cooking for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. If they start to brown, reduce the heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Add the stock, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, until it thickens slightly. Turn off the heat and stir in the chicken, sour cream, Dijon, tarragon, thyme, and pepper. Taste for salt and adjust as desired. Chill until fully cold or at least room temperature, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400˚F and line two sheet pans with parchment paper. If you have enough sheet pans, we like to stack a second sheet pan underneath each one so the bottoms of the pastry don't brown too quickly. On a floured surface, roll each sheet of puff pastry to about 13×13 inches. We use a 3 ½-inch circular cookie cutter for the bottoms – cut 9-10 circles from one sheet of puff pastry (or as many as you can fit). On the other sheet of puff pastry, we use a ~4-inch cookie cutter for the tops. Again, cut out 9-10 circles, or as many as you can fit. Mound 2 tablespoons of cooled filling on each bottom circle of puff pastry, leaving a border around the edges. Brush egg wash all around the border. Top with the slightly bigger top circle, pressing firmly all the way around the edges to make sure it's well sealed and there are no air pockets. Use a fork to firmly crimp the edges together. Optional: use the 3 ½-inch cookie cutter to re-trim the circle so it looks neat! Brush the tops of each pastry with a thin, but even layer of egg wash. Using a sharp paring knife, poke several holes in the top so steam can escape. To decorate with thyme leaves, dip the sprig in some egg wash, then press it onto the top of the pastry. Bake for ~22 minutes, rotating the pan at 15 minutes, until the pastries are deep golden on both the top and bottom. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

Coca-Cola Cake 🥤🍫 This old-fashioned Coca-Cola Cake is rich, incredibly moist, and covered with a warm chocolate frosting that melts right into the cake. Mini marshmallows bake into the batter, giving this nostalgic 9×13 cake an extra-soft texture. You can get the more detailed version with extra tips, step-by-step help, and a printable recipe on my website. Visit my blog through the link in my bio! For the cake: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 cups granulated sugar ½ teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup Coca-Cola 1 cup salted butter ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder ½ cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mini marshmallows For the frosting: ½ cup salted butter 3 Tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 6 Tablespoons Coca-Cola 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3¾ cups powdered sugar 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, optional Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish. Whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the Coca-Cola, butter, and cocoa powder. Heat until the butter melts and the mixture just begins to simmer, whisking occasionally. Pour the hot cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until combined. Add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla, stirring just until smooth. Fold in the mini marshmallows. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. About five minutes before the cake finishes baking, melt the butter with the cocoa powder and Coca-Cola in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove it from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth. Stir in the nuts, if using. Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread it evenly. Let the frosting set before slicing. #cocacolacake #chocolatecake #southerndessert #oldfashionedrecipes #cakerecipe Coca-Cola cake recipe, old-fashioned Coca-Cola cake, Southern chocolate cake, chocolate sheet cake, 9×13 cake recipe, chocolate cake with warm frosting, nostalgic dessert recipe

One-pan Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta🔥483 cals 53g protein 13g fat 39g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 servings 2.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced 10 oz uncooked pasta (rigatoni) 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1/2 an orange bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp minced garlic 3 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block 1/3 fat cream cheese or 8 oz 50g grated Parmesan Homemade Cajun Seasoning: 2 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp garlic powder 1½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano 1 tsp dried thyme 1 tsp black pepper ½–1 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp salt Directions: 1. Mix together all of your Cajun seasoning. 2. Season the diced chicken generously with about ⅔ of the seasoning. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until browned on the outside but not completely cooked through. 4. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. 5. Add the uncooked pasta, chicken broth and remaining Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 10–13 minutes, stirring every few minutes so the pasta doesn’t stick. 7. Cook until the pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. 8. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until everything comes together into a thick, creamy Cajun sauce. 9. Let it sit for 2–3 minutes to thicken, divide into 6 containers and you’ve got meal prep for the week! Follow for more #mealprep #highprotein #cajunchicken #chickenpasta #fatlossrecipes

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. #freepalestine🇵🇸❤️ #palistanegaza #rek #fyp #foryou The question of Palestine is one of the most complex and painful issues in modern world politics. The Palestinian cause is not merely a territorial dispute — it touches on questions of justice, human rights, and national self-determination. The slogan "Free Palestine" has become a symbol of the Palestinian people's aspiration for freedom, dignity, and their own statehood. Understanding this issue requires examining its historical roots, the current humanitarian situation, the legal framework, and the arguments of all sides. Historical Context The modern history of Palestine begins with the collapse of the Ottoman Empire after World War I, when the territory came under British administration through a League of Nations mandate. In 1917, the Balfour Declaration expressed British support for a "national home for the Jewish people" in Palestine, while also stating that the rights of existing non-Jewish communities should not be prejudiced. In 1947, the United Nations adopted Resolution 181, proposing the partition of Palestine into separate Jewish and Arab states, with Jerusalem under international administration. The Jewish leadership accepted the plan; the Arab leadership rejected it. In 1948, the State of Israel was declared, triggering the first Arab-Israeli war. Around 700,000 Palestinians fled or were expelled — an event Palestinians call the Nakba, meaning "catastrophe."

People are wasting their time building AI agents. A model on its own needs context to be useful: prompts and instructions, tools it can call, and data it can trust. The old way was to write code that wires those three to the model, call it agent one, and do it again for every workflow. Harnesses like Claude Code and Codex already let an AI read and write your files, so you can put your prompts, tools and data in folders and let one AI become whatever agent your question needs. If you want something to study for the next ten years, I'd pick the Unix philosophy, Douglas Engelbart's 1962 report Augmenting Human Intellect, and plain old software logic. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. It emerged as a subculture in the early 2010s through internet fashion communities, especially on platforms like Tumblr. Unlike classic goth fashion, which is usually dominated by black clothing, dark makeup, and a more serious atmosphere, pastel goth mixes dark themes with cute or dreamy visuals. Common colors include pastel pink, lavender, mint, baby blue, and white, often paired with black accents. The style frequently includes oversized sweaters, skirts, platform shoes, chokers, harnesses, fishnets, crosses, chains, bows, and accessories inspired by alternative Japanese fashion. Hairstyles often feature dyed hair in pastel shades such as pink, lilac, or silver. Visually, pastel goth combines motifs like skulls, bats, moons, crosses, and occult symbols with soft elements such as hearts, plush toys, clouds, and candy-like color palettes. This contrast creates an aesthetic that feels both cute and dark at the same time. Pastel goth also strongly influenced digital art, photography, and online aesthetics. In artwork, it is often represented through soft lighting, dreamy pastel tones, melancholic characters, gothic fashion details, and surreal or dark fantasy themes.

Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant
